mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_session (user_id, record_id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recordId}, #{title}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_ai_message e WHERE e.session_id = s.id)

SELECT p.id, p.record_id, p.title, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.message_count, m.`role` AS last_role, m.content AS last_content, m.image_url AS last_image_url FROM ( SELECT s.id, s.record_id, s.title, s.created_at, s.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_message c WHERE c.session_id = s.id) AS message_count, (SELECT MAX(l.id) FROM t_ai_message l WHERE l.session_id = s.id AND (l.content <> '' OR (l.image_url IS NOT NULL AND l.image_url <> ''))) AS last_message_id FROM t_ai_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_ai_message e WHERE e.session_id = s.id) ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size} ) p LEFT JOIN t_ai_message m ON m.id = p.last_message_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_ai_session WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
